## Sophia modules (sophia.html) · 2 passages

- **hillary**: … veto (14-1) against a resolution condemning the settlements as illegal — the exact action that blocked international censure of the policy she'd just called illegitimate days earlier. 2011, on Palestinian statehood Publicly opposed the Palestinian bid for full UN membership, arguing the path to statehood “runs through Jerusalem and Ramallah, not New York.” She did not personally run the Israeli-Palestinian negotiations track — that was delegated to special envoy George Mitchell, a documented structural fact that limits how much of the substantive outcome (or its failure) is attributable to her personally versus the broader administration. A former State spokesperson under her, P.J.
- **hillary**: Documented, and worth stating precisely because it cuts against a simple 'hands-on Israel advocate' reading: as Secretary of State she made only a handful of trips to Israel — a first visit in March 2009 (Jerusalem and Ramallah, days after taking office), then a documented two-year gap before her next one, her fourth visit overall coming in July 2012. The Council on Foreign Relations noted at the time that her predecessor, Condoleezza Rice, had visited roughly 20 times. The most-cited structural reason: Obama assigned the direct day-to-day Israeli-Palestinian diplomacy to special envoys (first George Mitchell, later Dennis Ross) rather than to her personally — a documented delegation of the portfolio, not an inferred one.
